prompt:
Make one opaque pixel-art eye atlas for common portrait NPC084 ANGRY, using this single image as the exact source/reference. Canvas: exact 2 columns × 2 rows, equal cells, overall aspect ratio 64:35 (about 1.83:1), each cell represents a native 64×35 eye-area crop. No gutters, margins, labels, borders, text, or extra panels. Row-major order: top-left LEFT/open; top-right RIGHT/open; bottom-left LEFT/half; bottom-right RIGHT/half. Both eyes glance together in each cell.

Preserve this exact angry expression, brow shape and position, eye spacing, original face, source palette, pixel scale, compact iris size and source eyelid contours. Keep each eye opening exactly as the source phase shows it: source open aperture in the top row, source half-lid aperture and coverage in the bottom row. Do not widen, enlarge, lift, or reshape either eyelid or aperture. Change only the iris/pupil placement by a gentle horizontal glance of about one native pixel: toward the viewer's left in LEFT cells and toward the viewer's right in RIGHT cells. Keep both small pupils fully inside the source opening and naturally bounded by the existing lids.

Match the actual source iris hue exactly: muted olive/hazel brown-green, not blue or gray. Keep the original dark pupils and subtle warm sclera. No broad bright sclera bands, large pale patches, bright-white glare, increased contrast, oversized irises, perfect circles, or new shiny reflections. Tiny restrained glints only at the source's original subdued intensity. Do not change brows, forehead, hair, skin, nose, face, background, crop, or anything outside the eye features. Preserve crisp native pixel edges; no smoothing, blur, antialiasing, resampling, or invented colors. Return only the requested four cells, with no closed or vertical gaze.
